needscope.reading: Positions captured on the interactive wheel: Heritage, Mother Dairy, Amul (GCMMF), Nandini (KMF), Hatsun (Arokya).

cb: Trusted daily fresh-milk staple in core South India markets.
Chosen for freshness & availability — habit more than active choice.
Under-indexed in curd/ghee trade-up & quick-commerce baskets.
db: Actively chosen across occasions: nutrition, festive gifting, trade-up.
Curd → ghee → beverages within the Heritage franchise.
Beyond the South via quick-commerce with purity-led advocacy.
cb_ca_db_da.ca_quote: "The fresh, dependable local milk we've always trusted — pure, but just milk."
cb_ca_db_da.da_quote: "Heritage is how I give my family pure strength every day — a daily act of care."
da_declarative: Purity I choose strength I see
cb_ca_db_da.shift_line: From dependable purity to chosen family strength.
cb_ca_db_da.caption: Layer family strength on top of trusted purity — never replace it.

smp_defence.why_collapses: Claims taste & ubiquity but its register is wit, not freshness-led purity.
Shares trust but has never made strength its story.
Owns regional belonging, not a purity proposition a mother chooses.
Competes on scale & price, cannot earn 'strength' without abandoning value.

smp_unlocks.mass_line: Har ghar ki rozaana shakti — Heritage.
smp_unlocks.activation: A 'Strength of Purity' festive platform with farm-to-family transparency.
